Name: [CP] The Gremio's Captain
Author: Rupnan
TagLine: The Guild’s Captain is a narrative expansion that introduces a 27-year-old military strategist to the Valley. More than just a simple NPC, he is a living system of interaction that redefines the safety and social life of Pelican Town.
Description:
The Guild’s Captain: Kaelen

A veteran of the Iron Hills seeks purpose in the silence of the mountain.

Character Overview

Kaelen is no ordinary adventurer. He is a Captain deployed from Castle Village to ensure the stability of the Pelican Town mines. Disciplined, stoic, and marked by the scars of war, Kaelen brings a mature, military perspective to the Valley. 
Will you manage to pierce through his steel armor and discover the man hidden behind the rank?

Main Features

A New Neighbor with a Past: A deep-lore NPC tied to the Shadowlands and the military history of the Ferngill Republic.
Military Rank System: As you progress through the mines and earn his trust, Kaelen will grant you official titles, from Forward Sentry to becoming his Right Hand.
Dynamic Events: Over 15 story events featuring interactions with Kent, Abigail, the Wizard, Marlon, and Lewis.
World Integration: Unique reactions to the Community Center, the Joja path, and the Skull Cavern.
Combat Mentorship: Receive tactical advice and unique equipment based on your skill level.

SVE Compatibility & Integration

This mod has been designed with Stardew Valley Expanded in mind:
Full SVE Support: Kaelen recognizes and interacts with locations and lore added by SVE.
Castle Village Lore: Deepens the connection between the Valley and the military forces of Castle Village.
Adventurer's Guild Expanded: Includes specific dialogue and interactions if you have the Guild expanded.

 Unique Relationships

• Kent: A profound connection regarding the front lines and a long-overdue message from a mutual old friend.
• Abigail: A mentorship and optional romance dynamic where rebellion clashes with discipline.
• The Guild: Kaelen works side-by-side with Marlon, elevating the importance of the Adventurer's Guild in the game.
• Linus: As the protector of the mountain, Kaelen ensures that no one harasses those who simply seek to live in peace.

 Items and Rewards

Through his quests and friendship, you can obtain:
Tactical Boots: Military-grade reinforced footwear.
Cyan Spatha: His personal sword, a mountain-forged blade with a permanent frost-like glow.
Guild Supplies: High-quality tonics and survival materials.


Highly Recommended:
Stardew Valley Expanded (SVE): Kaelen's story is most immersive when played alongside SVE lore.

Installation: Unzip the file into your

Mods folder and prepare to stand guard.
